topic.title: Visual Cortex Models and Brain-Aligned Representations
topic.overview: This topic links artificial visual representations with brain activity, studying both brain-inspired computation and models that predict recorded neural responses. Hierarchical structure, recurrence, predictive feedback, and transfer across subjects appear throughout the representatives. Similarity to brain measurements is an empirical target, not evidence that two systems implement the same mechanism.
topic.whyItMatters: Cross-subject transfer can reduce expensive data collection, while controlled comparisons reveal which aspects of neural activity a model actually captures. Strong visual decoding does not necessarily imply accurate prediction of stable individual traits.
topic.evolution: Early examples represent part–whole hierarchies with bottom-up and top-down pathways. Later work compares task-derived networks with cortical responses and reconstructs images from activity. Recent models use few-shot in-context adaptation and large-scale fMRI pretraining; benchmark null results on trait prediction provide an important counterweight to success on cognitive-state decoding.
openQuestions: Which representational similarities predict useful transfer to unseen subjects?
How can models distinguish genuine neural structure from acquisition-specific regularities?

papers.tldr: Attention-based brain encoders improve visual-response prediction and offer an interpretable candidate model of content-dependent visual routing.

papers.title: What Moves the Eyes: Doubling Mechanistic Model Performance Using Deep Networks to Discover and Test Cognitive Hypotheses
papers.tldr: DeepGaze III guides interpretable extensions to SceneWalk that double its explained variance on MIT1003 from 35% to 70%.

papers.title: ZEBRA: Towards Zero-Shot Cross-Subject Generalization for Universal Brain Visual Decoding
papers.tldr: ZEBRA disentangles subject identity from visual semantics to reconstruct images from unseen subjects' fMRI without subject-specific adaptation.

papers.title: A Deep Learning Model of Mental Rotation Informed by Interactive VR Experiments
papers.tldr: A model combining spatial encoding, symbolic descriptions, and simulated rotations reproduces several aspects of human mental-rotation behavior.

papers.title: Alignment between Brains and AI: Evidence for Convergent Evolution across Modalities, Scales and Training Trajectories
papers.tldr: Across 630 AI models, stronger performance correlates with greater brain alignment, which also emerges as an early predictor of learning progress.

papers.title: BrainJanus: A Unified Model for Understanding and Generation across Brain, Vision, and Language
papers.tldr: BrainJanus uses a shared token representation to model both directions of correspondence among brain activity, images, and language.

papers.title: Contrastive Diffusion Alignment: Learning Structured Latents for Controllable Generation
papers.tldr: ConDA organizes pretrained diffusion representations into a smaller, interpretable space for controlling generation along meaningful dynamical directions.

papers.title: Cross-Subject Modeling for Widefield Calcium Imaging via Atlas-Aligned Spatiotemporal Tokenization
papers.tldr: WiCAT uses atlas-grounded self-supervised representations to transfer widefield calcium-imaging models across subjects and decode behavior on unseen subjects.

papers.title: Dynamic Fractal Mamba: A Neural Renormalization Group Flow for Scale-Invariant Sequence Modeling
papers.tldr: DF-Mamba shares a recursive state-space operator across scales, enabling efficient modeling and zero-shot generalization to larger temporal and spatial inputs.

papers.title: Inside the Visual Mind: Neuroscience-Motivated Concept Circuits for Interpreting and Steering Vision Transformers
papers.tldr: ViSAE identifies concept circuits in vision transformers and uses concept editing to improve reported worst-group performance.

papers.title: Interpreting Physics in Video World Models
papers.tldr: Video encoders represent physical information in distributed hierarchies, with motion direction becoming accessible at a distinct intermediate-depth transition.

papers.title: Kuramoto Oscillatory Phase Encoding: Neuro-inspired Synchronization for Improved Learning Efficiency
papers.tldr: KoPE adds evolving, synchronizing phase states to Vision Transformers to improve learning efficiency and structured visual understanding.

papers.title: Mind-Omni: A Unified Multi-Task Framework for Brain-Vision-Language Modeling via Discrete Diffusion
papers.tldr: Mind-Omni tokenizes brain signals and uses discrete diffusion to unify seven brain–vision–language tasks with reported benefits from joint learning.

papers.title: Multimodal Scaling Laws for Task & Data-Optimized Models of Visual Cortex
papers.tldr: A broad study finds saturating pretraining gains and substantial benefits from neural-data fine-tuning and larger model-to-brain mapping datasets.

papers.title: NeurIPS: Neuro-anatomical Inductive Priors for Sphere-based Brain Decoding
papers.tldr: NeurIPS uses cortical anatomy and efficient spherical tokenization to improve surface-based fMRI decoding and accelerate adaptation across subjects.

papers.title: Real-World Unsupervised Models Generalize to Predict Brain Responses to Out-of-Distribution Stimuli
papers.tldr: Unsupervised models trained on real-world data better predict sensory brain responses and generalize across language and visual-experience differences.

papers.title: Revisiting Neural Processes via Fourier Transform and Volterra Series
papers.tldr: Fourier convolutions and Volterra expansions give neural processes efficient global access to irregular observations and more explicit operator structure.

papers.title: SAEs-BrainMap: Unveiling the Emergence of Specialized Concepts in Deep Models via Brain Alignment
papers.tldr: SAEs-BrainMap aligns sparse model features with visual brain responses to interpret concepts and trace their progression across network layers.

papers.title: Scaling Vision Transformers for Functional MRI with Flat Maps
papers.tldr: CortexMAE uses cortical flat maps for fMRI transformers, improving cognitive-state decoding while trait prediction remains challenging.

papers.title: SleepMaMi: A Universal Sleep Foundation Model for Integrating Macro- and Micro-structures
papers.tldr: SleepMaMi learns full-night sleep structure and short-term biosignal patterns together, supporting generalizable and label-efficient downstream analysis.

papers.title: Structure Abstraction and Generalization in a Hippocampal-Entorhinal Inspired World Model
papers.tldr: A hippocampal-entorhinal-inspired world model separates relational structure from episodic scenes and demonstrates structural reuse on rotation dynamics.
